system.flavor:
When something big comes at the room, move yourself and one friend out of its path together: the scaffold toppling, the cart coming through the stall, the crowd breaking into a stampede, the wave over the rail. You go the same way at the same moment.

Not enough to move more than two people or outrun what is already on top of you.

body.label: Target
body.html: Self and one willing ally within 2 units, or self alone.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Trigger: An area Action is declared including at least one target. Response (unopposed): Each target moves 1 unit; recheck the area afterward.

surges.html: Each target still in the area reduces that Action's Damage by 1.
